1 Scientific Literature.Title: Crystallization of Free Lime and Magnesia from Molten LD-converter Slag
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Aribumi Niida, Kazuo Okohira, Arata Tanaka, Tsuyoshi Kai
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Study crystallization of free lime and free magnesia from molten MgO-saturated LD-converter slag under different cooling conditions and basicities.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Free lime exists as undissolved and crystallized lime. Rapidly cooled slag with basicity >4 contains primary lime (Lpri) and peritectoid lime (Lper); slowly cooled slag contains Lwus, LC3S and Lres. Free MgO forms magnesio-wustite. Under MgO saturation, crystallized lime forms above CaO/SiO2 = 3 or (CaO+MnO+MgO)/SiO2 = 4.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Paper in Japanese with English synopsis and figure/table captions. Nippon Steel Yawata Works. Mentions cement raw material as one current use of converter slag.
